description: ROM Ali Jump Initiation, Weapon Hotkey Swap & Dagger Attack Dispatcher

routines.name: ali_jump_initiation
routines.purpose: Jump Button C entry: verifies ground state, sets ledge/jump state 0x14 / anim 0x14, plays SFX 0x900359, unrolls stack

routines.name: ali_weapon_hotkey_swap
routines.purpose: Weapon quick-swap: scans slot at $FF0D80, dispatches weapon type (0x0A Dagger, 0x0C Sword, 0x0E Bow, 0x10 Bomb), HUD toast 60f, SFX 0xC0025D or 0xA00253

routines.name: ali_attack_weapon_router
routines.purpose: Evaluates weapon index at $FF0D7E (routes 0x0C Sword, 0x0E Bow, 0x10 Bomb) and initializes Dagger strike (anim 0x3A, state 0x0A, combo timer $FF198B = 4)
